verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly positions itself as an AI runtime platform with AgentControl configs and Autopilot, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence only documents LaunchDarkly's own MCP server (local and hosted), which external AI clients like Cursor or Claude Code connect to. That is the server role, not the client capability this story asks about, and nothing in the pack shows LaunchDarkly connecting to MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
